q: You want a new form response to trigger a draft reply automatically. Which tool fits?
options: A no-code flow tool like Zapier, Make or n8n
explanation: No-code flow tools connect your apps — new form response leads to draft reply — and you build the flow visually by connecting boxes, not by programming. ChatGPT Tasks and Claude Projects schedule AI jobs but do not connect apps this way.

q: Which automation sits in the sweet spot described in the lesson?
options: A daily briefing delivered each morning for you to read
A flow that moves client payments automatically
An automation that holds your passwords
Follow-up emails sent to clients without review
explanation: The sweet spot is work that produces a draft or a nudge, with you doing the final judgement. Money and secrets are the two things you never automate.

q: A no-code tool asks for a credit card during sign-up. What should you do?
options: Enter the card to unlock the free tier
Stop — you do not need a paid plan to start
Use your company card and expense it later
explanation: Zapier, Make and n8n all have free tiers, so no card is needed to start. The lesson's rule is clear: if a tool asks for a credit card, stop — you don't need one.
